ds-dropdown removed; ds-select is the canonical select-only picker (CVA, invalid+hint, required/optional, per-option icons, readOnly). After the selector rename also apply dropdown-error-input-rename and dropdown-option-groups-fold (separate items).
On elements migrated from ds-dropdown to ds-select: [error] -> [invalid] (and static error="..." -> invalid="...").

[optionGroups]="groups" is gone on ds-select — pass groups inline in [options]: SelectItem = SelectOption | SelectOptionGroup, so merge the flat options and the groups into one [options] array (order = desired render order).

ds-search's inner input class renamed (over-generic .input let consumer global styles leak in). Only consumer STYLING that targeted the undocumented internal class is affected — scope strictly to selectors under ds-search.

Trigger is now an editable masked text input by default (allowInput defaults true) with a trailing calendar icon, and the field sizes to CONTENT width (was full-width). Pass [allowInput]="false" for the old click-only field; set a width on the host to stretch. Usually no code change — flag for visual review (eyeball).

Default max-width changed 320px -> none (ds-search now stretches like the rest of the field family). If the 320px cap was relied on, set --ds-search-maxw: 320px on the host/theme. Usually visual-review only.

informational: New ds-time-picker (24h/12h via provideDsConfig, range mode, CVA) — additive.

Selection controls gain size + required; standalone ds-radio gains invalid/hint; input/textarea maxLength counter; date-picker minDate/maxDate/disabledDate/presets + locale/dateFormat/firstDayOfWeek/defaultMonth manual masked entry; select clearable/icons/readOnly; autocomplete optionGroups/allowCreate/width=content; table expandable rows; modal closeOnBackdrop/persistent/xl/fullscreen; drawer placement/sm; bottom-sheet snapPoints; toast loading/promise/maxVisible; menu dividers/submenus; popover arrow/placement; tabs lazy/scrollable/closable/vertical; accordion single-open/item disabled; stepper clickable/errorSteps/vertical; sidenav collapsed tooltip; badge count/max; avatar status/fallbackIcon — all additive.
Public --ds-* customization token sweep across ~44 components (~160-180 new names) — purely additive resolvers, zero visual change when unset.

Visual-only: rounded press feedback (+ --ds-press-brightness/--ds-press-scale tuning tokens) and native tap-highlight suppression; accessibility hardening across overlays/pickers/fields/cards (dialog semantics, Tab close, role=alert re-announce, labels).
